name: SRE · etcd without leader · 1m
description: Checks etcd without leader · 1m. Values are evaluated every 60 seconds. Windows apply to observed samples; inspect collection health before interpreting a missing result. Thresholds are starting points to review against the workload baseline.
remediation:
1. Identify the cluster and node in the title. Check etcd quorum and peer connectivity.
2. Compare leader changes, WAL writes, database commits, peer round trips, pod restarts and previous logs at the same time.
3. Preserve snapshots before recovery. Never remove a member or restore a snapshot based on this alert alone.

name: SRE · missing node OS telemetry · 5m
query: min_over_time((((max by (cluster_name,node) (kubernetes_state_node_age) * 0 + 1) unless on (cluster_name,node) (max by (cluster_name,node) (up{job="sre-node"} == 1))) or on (cluster_name,node) (max by (cluster_name,node) (kubernetes_state_node_age) * 0))[5m:30s])
description: Checks missing node OS telemetry · 5m. Values are evaluated every 60 seconds. Windows apply to observed samples; inspect collection health before interpreting a missing result. Thresholds are starting points to review against the workload baseline.
remediation:
1. Check the collector pod, readiness, recent and previous logs.
2. Verify DNS, TLS, NetworkPolicy, endpoint reachability, ingestion credentials and remote-write responses.
3. Check queue growth and dropped samples. A running pod does not prove successful delivery.

name: SRE · PVC filesystem below 10 percent available · 15m
query: max_over_time(((max by (cluster_name,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (kubernetes_kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes) / max by (cluster_name,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (kubernetes_kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes)) and on (cluster_name,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (max by (cluster_name,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (kubernetes_kubelet_volume_stats_inodes) > 0))[15m:30s])
titleTemplate: SRE · PVC filesystem below 10 percent available · 15m · ${cluster_name} · ${namespace} · ${persistentvolumeclaim}
description: Checks PVC filesystem below 10 percent available · 15m. Values are evaluated every 60 seconds. Windows apply to observed samples; inspect collection health before interpreting a missing result. Thresholds are starting points to review against the workload baseline.
remediation:
1. Locate the named cluster, namespace and PVC. Check available bytes and recent growth inside the mounted filesystem.
2. Verify snapshots, retention, application writes and StorageClass expansion support.
3. Forecasts are trends, not guarantees; compare several time windows before resizing or deleting data.

name: SRE · host disk response above 20ms · 10m
description: Average disk response exceeds 20 ms throughout observed samples in a 10-minute window, while the five-minute average activity is at least 1 operation/s. This is an initial investigation threshold, not a universal storage SLA.
remediation: Identify node and device. Compare disk response, operations in progress, workload IOPS and storage backend health. Check the same time window for application latency. Do not reboot, replace a disk or delete data based only on this threshold.
